verdict.rationale: Render documents an official CLI to "manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal" and to validate render.yaml Blueprints. That makes terminal-based deployment workflows plausible, but no item explicitly documents a CLI deploy command or creating a new project without the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a CLI deploy/trigger-deploy command, evidence that initial service creation works without the dashboard, and independent hands-on corroboration of CLI-only deploys.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my project directly from the command line without using a web dashboard

citations.quote: Use the Render CLI to manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal
